summary: iter343 FL Login Chrome Rebuild — Backend + UI tests for /leadership/login. 15/15 iter343 regression suite green. 49/49 iter32x/33x/34x combined suites green. Backend behavior confirmed via live curl: super-admin 401 (by design), FL user happy-path 200+token, wrong-pw 401, forgot-password generic 200, legacy /api/field-leadership/login wrong-pw 401. UI confirmed chrome parity with /hr/login (blueprint-bg, caution-stripe, slate-900 header w/ MasciLogo+LangToggle+Home, max-w-md card with red badge, mail-prefixed h-12 inputs, Remember-me + Forgot password row, full-width red uppercase Sign In, PortalLoginHelp, legacy disclosure, footer count=2). FL happy-path E2E succeeds — welcome toast appears, masci.fl.token written, lands at /leadership Hub. Sign-out clears BOTH masci.fl.token and masci.leadership.token. Mobile 390 layout: no horizontal overflow, submit button full-width (292px in 390 viewport). Forgot-password dialog opens, calm toast shows for non-existent email (no enumeration leak). Legacy gate /leadership/legacy-login renders [data-testid=leadership-login-form]. HR side-by-side at 1440x900 has identical chrome (blueprint-bg + caution-stripe + slate-900 header + footer=2). ONE LIVE-UI CONCERN: clicking the ES segment of the LangToggle in playwright did not visibly switch any of the 9 FL-specific strings on the login form — all ES probes failed and 'Sign In' / 'Forgot password?' remained in English in the rendered DOM. The static i18n.js test_es_translations_complete_for_fl_login passes (keys ARE in the dictionary), so the bug (if any) is in runtime binding OR the test clicked the wrong segment. Main agent should manually verify ES toggle visually on the live preview.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright click on ES segment of LangToggle did not switch the visible page strings to Spanish (all 9 required ES phrases absent from DOM after click; 'Sign In' / 'Forgot password?' remained in EN). Static i18n.js dictionary contains the required pairs (unit test green). Could be a selector mismatch OR a runtime t() wiring gap. Main agent should manually click ES toggle in browser and visually confirm Spanish renders for: Inicio, LIDERAZGO DE CAMPO, Iniciar Sesión, Correo de Trabajo, Contraseña, Recordarme en este dispositivo, ¿Olvidaste tu contraseña?, MASCI · Portal de Liderazgo de Campo, ¿Tu cuadrilla usa un código compartido?

critical_code_review_comments: FieldLeadershipPortalLogin.jsx is a clean structural mirror of HrLogin.jsx — palette-only differences (red-700 vs purple-700). DRY-friendly: imports shared PortalLoginHelp/MasciLogo/LangToggle/ForgedOpsAttribution/operationalError. Good token hygiene: clears all sibling portal tokens before login.
Auth model documentation in the file header is excellent — clearly states super-admin is NOT accepted here and explains the admin-aware shortcut.

Calm-error mapping (401/423/429/timeout/no-response) is the most complete I've seen in the portal family — could be extracted to a shared portal-login error helper to enforce parity across HR/PM/Shop/Dispatch/Safety/FL.
